dc50bda4ca1df3b2.g: Lightkeeper can be found on the Lighthouse location. He is located in a locked area on the 3rd floor of the lighthouse building at the peninsula territory. The bridge that leads to the lighthouse is guarded by Zryachiy and full of Claymores. To safely pass the bridge and speak to Lightkeeper, an encoded Digital secure DSP radio transmitter is required. It deactivates the claymores and has Zryachiy not shoot you. The questline to obtain one starts with the quest Network Provider - Part 1, which is given out by Mechanic after finishing the previous objective. Harming Zryachiy, one of his followers, or a Lightkeeper acquainted PMC in the lighthouse premises will decode your Digital secure DSP radio transmitter if you have it equipped (Attention: Unequipping it does not prevent this in local PvE game mode raids).
